info.name: Resource Service
info.description: In Kahoots with the Undead — Resource Service API. Covers the CRUD endpoints over /api/resource-types and /api/inventory through the Gateway, the idempotent gather / spend / refund endpoints and inventory creation that Game, Base and Crafting Service call (through the message broker, since the Gateway refuses them), the node lookup, and GET /metrics. Owner: Costin Loredana.

Reading, setting and deleting an inventory stay available through the Gateway.

item.name: Resource Economy (Game, Base and Crafting Service routes, through the Message Broker)
item.description: POST /api/gather (Game Service), POST /api/spend and POST /api/refund (Base and Crafting Service) are refused by the Gateway (404 route_not_found), so the collection checks that, then sends them to resource-service's queue in the message broker with the token of the service that calls them. Idempotency is real: a repeated idempotencyKey answers already_applied without changing the balance. GET /api/nodes/{nodeId} stays available through the Gateway.
